newsitem.title: GERMANY: GEA CFO-no comment on APV bid prospects.
newsitem.headline: GEA CFO-no comment on APV bid prospects.

text.p: German engineering group Gea AG on Monday declined to comment on speculation it may submit a counter-offer for British engineering firm APV plc following Siebe plc's bid for the group.
"We are not commenting on that issue at all," chief financial officer Klaus Sturany said in response to Reuters enquiries.
"But we have acknowledged Siebe's offer with interest," he added.
Shares in Siebe dropped on Monday amid negative comment on the company's 327.4 million pound acquisition of process engineering group APV.
There was also talk that Germany's GEA could make a counter bid for APV, whose shares were down 1p at 105-1/2, though GEA made no reference to APV in its results statement on Monday.
